# DJI Osmo 360 II Launches With 8K60 And No American Price **DJI** put the **Osmo 360 II** on sale in China on Thursday, August 13, at 8:00 pm Beijing time, pricing the standard package at 3,299 yuan, about $460\. The second generation of DJI’s panoramic camera records native 8K video at 60 frames per second, swaps its lenses by hand, and ships with 105GB of internal storage\. The company’s US store, checked minutes after the reveal, returns a 404 page\. ## The Launch Sheet Confirms The Leaks And Adds The Fine Print The Osmo 360 II records native panoramic video at 7680 by 3840 pixels from 24 to 60 frames per second, meters up to 14\.5 stops of dynamic range by DJI’s lab numbers, and takes user-replaceable lenses hardened with an ion sputtering coating, according to the specifications DJI published at launch\. A week of pre-launch reporting called the headline features correctly\. When DroneXL covered the Chinese pre-order window on August 7, the expected package was 8K60 and swappable lenses\.
